errors.text: The proposed W-V-Ta-Ti-Cr refractory coating is intrinsically heavy and does not address the requested lightweight-alloy objective or relative-density optimization.
The hypothesis replaces the target MgAlTiVFeCo powder/SPS route with an unrelated laser-cladded refractory coating system.
The 2.83 J/mm threshold is transferred from selective laser melting of NbMoTaW, not demonstrated for laser cladding of WVTaTiCr; it therefore cannot support the claimed BCC/Laves-phase boundary.
No aqueous-corrosion experiment is included, despite aqueous corrosion resistance being a primary requested property.
The claimed optimal Cr range, continuous Cr2O3 formation, Laves-phase suppression, oxidation-rate reduction, and 100-hour scale adhesion are not established by the cited excerpts.
